single_change: Change only graph-level raw observation accessibility from historical broadcast-to-every-cell to deterministic fixed sparse input connectivity; all ordinary cell equations, state/message dimensions, topology, optimizer/training budget, tasks, data regions, metrics and original V837 gates remain unchanged.
capacity_aggregation: A family satisfies a density setting iff median development success across 8 independent paired replicates is >=0.90 and median validation success is >=0.85. The density screen succeeds iff >=4/5 families satisfy that unchanged per-family capacity criterion.
density_selection_rule: highest median number of families passing per replicate

partial_improvement_rule.improvement_evidence: paired bootstrap 95% CI for sparse-minus-broadcast mean validation success has lower bound > 0

baseline_reproduction_tolerance.comparison: first three paired restarts against preserved blocker_diagnostic_results best validation score

no_message_semantics: Raw input mask and recurrent cell state remain active; every cell-to-cell message contribution is forced to zero during both training and evaluation.
